title: Intel forward adjusted earnings presentation bridge: frozen accounting conventions
scope: A 2027-2028 issuer-style adjustedEPS proxy and exact bridge back to the unchanged economic cash model. It is not a complete GAAP income statement, issuer guidance, exact sell-side forecast reconstruction or revised valuation.

chronology.choice: All presentation assumptions selected before forward EPS calculation. Existing operating forecasts remain untouched.

actual_Q3_2026_validation.GAAP_EPS_special_numerator: GAAP diluted numerator subtracts120M of escrow derivative gain associated with diluted contingent shares; do not carry that numerator adjustment into normalizedEPS when the whole escrow mark is already excluded.
actual_Q3_2026_validation.note: Small alternative-method residual is issuer rounding. Actual ratio validates consolidated pretax tax then adjustedNCI subtraction.

central_reference.tax_classification: Carry forward the current2026 issuer nonGAAP normalized rate solely as a comparison convention. Not2027-2028 guidance, notGAAP tax expense and notthe existing15%cash tax rate.
central_reference.share_classification: Existing economic planning claims, not a forecast of GAAP weighted diluted shares. No-new-funding reference; exact future grant/vesting and treasury-stock dilution unknown.
central_reference.NCI_rationale: Q3 issuer excludes37M of adjustments attributable to minority owners; annualizing gives148M. Rounded150M per year is a planning allowance, not guidance; use0 and300M sensitivities.
central_reference.book_DA_convention: Mirror the existing financing-tax-model cohort convention for this approximation:1B annual capitalized interest,8year straight-line life, begins the following year.0in2027 and.125in2028. Book and tax lives are not actually established equal; show this as a chosen mapping rather than reported accounting. Current1Bcapitalized cash interest is not expensed again.
central_reference.unallocated_items_label: Reference EPS is before separately unallocated lease interest and NEW capital-incentive book depreciation benefit. Zero is absence of allocation in the reference, not proof the true amounts are zero. See required controls.
central_reference.excluded_nonrecurring_items: No equity remeasurement, divestiture gain, escrowmark or financing proceeds enters normalized earnings.
central_reference.packaging_SBC: Separate packaging central cost includes unsplitSBC. Do not add all of it back or invent anSBC fraction; retain it fully as expense in this limited proxy.

formula.symbols: E=economic consolidatedEBIT afterSBC; A=identified corporateSBC+acquisitionamortization+restructuring addbacks; K=newcapitalizedinterest bookDA; H=newcredit bookDAbenefit; L=incremental leaseinterest notalreadyinordinaryinterest; I=ordinaryinterest; Y=interestincome; t=nonGAAPnormalizedtax; N=GAAPNCIproxy; M=minority shareofnonGAAPadjustments; S=planning denominator.
formula.adjusted_pretax_profit: E + A - K + H - L - I + Y
formula.adjusted_parent_net_income: (E + A - K + H - L - I + Y)*(1-t) - N - M
formula.reverse_to_original_EBIT: (adjusted_parent_net_income + N + M)/(1-t) - A + K - H + L + I - Y
formula.cash_bridge_rule: Recover E first, then apply the original economic model cash identity unchanged. Do not simply add fullD&A to adjustedNI; acquisitionamortization has already been excluded from that numerator.
formula.original_owner_cash: E - ordinary_operating_cash_tax + originalDA - physicalcapex - workingcapital - all-inleasecash - minoritycashreserve + oldcreditcash + newcreditcash - creditbasislosscashtax - ordinarycashinterest - capitalizedcashinterest + cashinterestincome*(1-cashtaxrate) + conditionalfinancingtaxbenefit.

required_controls.lease_control_interpretation: 1B expenses the whole existing all-in supplier/lease cash envelope in addition to ordinary interest andD&A, so it is an intentionally severe diagnostic bound, not a likely accounting forecast. The source does not permit an exact financeleaseinterest split.

new_credit_book_benefit_control.illustration: New credit amounts4.2B2027 and4.9B2028 from existing eligiblebasis policy, assumed8year booklife and halfyearinservice:bookdepreciation benefit.2625B2027 and.83125B2028. This is an illustrative reportedearnings adjustment only, not incremental cash value.
new_credit_book_benefit_control.rule: Keep oldcapitalcreditcashcollections outofearnings. Do not also give a cash-tax benefit or reviseFCFF for this presentation adjustment.

required_controls.restructuring_addback_control: Also show proxy retaining the.20/.15B allowance as ordinary expense, since recurring assumed restructuring may not be treated identically by every analyst.

combined_adverse_presentation_control.interpretation: Stress of accounting/denominator conventions, not an operating downside probability or adopted financial forecast.

cash_and_dilution_guards: The economicDCF continues expensing recurringSBC; adding itback for an adjustedEPS comparison does not increase ownercash or value.

Future weighted dilutedshares depend on grants, vesting, price and assumedproceeds. The5.51planningclaimcount includes existingnetaward andescrow conventions, notfuturegrant issuance. Denominator controls are not a fully specifiedgrant model.
Minoritycashreserve is an economic attribution allowance. It is not actualpartnerdistributions; do not replaceonewiththeother silently.
Original1Ball-inleasecash allowance is chargedonce in cash. EPS expense mapping ofthatcash is incomplete. LeaseassetD&A is assumed within totalD&A already.
IssueradjustedFCF includespartnercapitalcontributions/netdistributions andgovernmentcash; parentowner cash convention differs. No exactreportedFCFforecast is claimed.
Capitalcreditbookbenefit lowersdepreciation and raisesadjustedearnings; it doesnot manufactureextraFCFF beyond already modeled cashcredits.

MarketEPS reference2027S&PviaStockAnalysis is explicitly nonGAAPadjusted. iFAST2028EPS2.59 is a publishedanalystestimate but fullfuture adjustments/tax/share methodology is notdisclosed. The comparison remains a normalizedproxy, not exact apples-to-apples certification.

source_facts.issuer_NCI: Remove minorityowners share of acquisition/SBC/restructuring/tax adjustments whereapplicable.
source_facts.capitalized_interest: Q32026expense is netof.264B capitalizedinterest;9Mcapitalized.806B. Capitalizedcash is notimmediateP&Linterestexpense.
source_facts.capital_incentives: Capitalincentives accounted as reductiontoassetbasis; recognizednewgrantbenefit occurs throughlowerfuturedepreciation. SelectedmodelphysicalEBITandDA precedeNEWgrantaccounting.
